1 Nora is going shopping.
2 Harry is going swimming.
3 Mel and Bob are going dancing.
4 Terry and Sarah are going sightseeing.
5 Nick is going fishing.
On Monday evening Jim is going to meet Tom and Ricky.
On Tuesday he is going to visit his grandmother.
On Wednesday he is going to meet Pat for dinner.
On Thursday morning he is going to go swimming.
On Thursday evening he is going to play table tennis with Mary.
On Friday he is going to do some housework.
On Friday he is also going to phone his Aunt Sally.
On Saturday he is going to buy Tom's birthday present.
On Sunday he is going to give Tom his present.
On Sunday he is also going to take Mary to Tom's party.
1 done; did   2 Does; doesn't; does   3 Did; did; didn't   4 do; done
1 What do you do?
2 What do you do at the weekends?
3 Let me do the washing-up / Let me do the dishes.
4 I always do the/my housework/cleaning on Saturdays.
5 I did my best / a lot of work but I failed / didn't pass the exam.
1 MICHAEL: What does your father do?
JANE: He's a lorry driver.
2 I don't like doing homework but I know I have to do it.
3 He does a lot of business with companies in the USA nowadays.
4 I saw her at the gym. She was doing some exercises that looked very hard.
5 DIANA: Liz, what are you doing with all those clothes?
